behavior.hint: Play this surface's footstep once per grid-size distance of committed token movement. The smallest configured Region wins overlaps. Requires an active GM viewing the scene.

mode.label: Playback strategy
mode.hint: Use the world default or choose a strategy for this surface. Changes apply to the next footstep.

soundPath.label: Footstep sound
soundPath.hint: An audio file containing a single footstep, ideally no longer than 2 seconds.

radius.label: Hearing radius
radius.hint: Maximum hearing distance, measured in the scene's distance units.

volume.label: Volume
volume.hint: Sound volume from 0 to 1. Foundry's Ambient volume control also applies.

easing.label: Volume easing
easing.hint: Checked: volume decreases with distance. Unchecked: constant volume within hearing range. Native walls and muffling still apply.

walls.label: Walls block footsteps
walls.hint: When unchecked, use Foundry's native lowpass muffling through walls.

mode.name: Default playback strategy
mode.hint: Used by surfaces set to Use world default. Create per step allows overlapping clips; Reuse per token stops the previous clip when the next step plays. Changes apply to the next footstep and do not affect surface overrides.

errors.clipDuration: Use a short footstep clip (1 second or less): {soundPath}
